sshModal.whySwitchDesc: HTTPS uses standard web port 443 which is always allowed across nearly all networks, ISPs, and firewalls without requiring complex SSH key setup.

workflowModal.title: GitHub Workflow Scope Required
workflowModal.subtitle: GitHub rejected the push because your Personal Access Token (PAT) lacks the 'workflow' scope.
workflowModal.explanation: The branch you are pushing creates or modifies GitHub Actions workflow files under .github/workflows/. For security reasons, GitHub requires your Personal Access Token to have the 'workflow' scope.
workflowModal.step1: Go to GitHub Developer Settings ➔ Personal Access Tokens.
workflowModal.step2Classic: For Classic Tokens: Check the 'workflow' scope (Update GitHub Action workflows).
workflowModal.step2FineGrained: For Fine-grained Tokens: Under Repository permissions, set 'Workflows' to 'Read and write'.
workflowModal.step3: Save changes on GitHub, then update your token in Forge Desktop's Accounts settings if needed.

gitErrors.workflowScopeDesc: GitHub rejected the push because your Personal Access Token lacks the 'workflow' scope.
gitErrors.secretDetectedDesc: GitHub blocked the push because it contains secrets or credentials (GH008). Remove secrets from commit history or use the official bypass link if safe.
gitErrors.protectedBranchDesc: Push was rejected because this branch is protected by branch rules (GH006). Changes must be made through a pull request.
gitErrors.largeFileDesc: GitHub rejected files larger than 100 MB (GH001). Use Git LFS or remove the large file from your commit.
gitErrors.pullNeededDesc: Push was rejected because the remote has changes you do not have locally. Pull or rebase the remote changes first.
gitErrors.localOverwrittenDesc: Operation aborted because your uncommitted local changes would be overwritten. Commit or stash your changes first.
gitErrors.authSamlDesc: Access was denied because your organization enforces SAML Single Sign-On on Personal Access Tokens.
gitErrors.divergentBranchesDesc: Local and remote branches have diverged. Specify how to reconcile (Merge or Rebase).

secretModal.title: Secret Detected / Push Protection
secretModal.subtitle: GitHub blocked this push because it detected sensitive tokens or credentials in your commit.
secretModal.explanation: Push was rejected by GitHub Push Protection because secrets or credentials were detected in your commits. For security, revoke or remove the secret from git history, or use the official bypass link if this is a false positive or test secret.
secretModal.option1: Remove the commit containing sensitive files (e.g. .env files or tokens) using git reset / git rebase.
secretModal.option2: Or visit the official bypass link above to confirm the secret if you have permission and it is safe/a test secret.

protectedBranchModal.title: Protected Branch Restriction
protectedBranchModal.subtitle: Direct push to branch "{branch}" was rejected by remote repository policies.
protectedBranchModal.explanation: This branch is protected or requires a Pull Request and code review before changes can be merged. You can create a new branch from your current commits and push it to open a Pull Request.
protectedBranchModal.newBranchLabel: New Branch Name for Pull Request:

stashPromptModal.title: Local File Conflict
stashPromptModal.subtitle: The {operation} operation would overwrite uncommitted local changes.
stashPromptModal.explanation: Git aborted {operation} because there are local changes in the files below that have not been committed. Would you like to save changes to Stash before continuing {operation}?

pullFirstModal.title: Remote Contains New Work (Pull First)
pullFirstModal.subtitle: Push to branch "{branch}" was rejected because remote has newer commits.
pullFirstModal.explanation: Git rejected the push (non-fast-forward) because the remote branch tip is ahead of your local branch. You need to pull the remote changes first before pushing your local commits.
pullFirstModal.fetchTooltip: Fetch remote commit references without merging into local branch

largeFileModal.title: File Exceeds 100 MB Limit
largeFileModal.subtitle: GitHub blocked this push because it detected large files in your commit (GH001).
largeFileModal.explanation: GitHub enforces a strict 100 MB maximum file size limit. The file identified below cannot be pushed through standard Git.
largeFileModal.option1Desc: Undo the last commit with a Soft Reset. Your work stays completely safe on disk/staging so you can unstage the large file or add it to .gitignore.
largeFileModal.option2Desc: Use Git LFS (Large File Storage) to track large binary files without bloating the Git repository.
largeFileModal.openLfsTooltip: Open installation and usage guide for Git Large File Storage
largeFileModal.softResetTooltip: Rollback commit to staging without losing any code changes (git reset --soft HEAD~1)

samlModal.title: SAML SSO Authorization Required
samlModal.subtitle: Organization enforces Single Sign-On authorization on your Personal Access Token.
samlModal.explanation: Access to this remote repository was denied because the owner organization enforces SAML SSO. Your Personal Access Token (PAT) must be explicitly authorized for this organization.
samlModal.step2: 2. Find your active token, click 'Configure SSO', then click 'Authorize' next to the relevant organization.
samlModal.step3: 3. Return to Forge Desktop and click 'Retry Push'.

divergentModal.title: Divergent Branches
divergentModal.subtitle: Local and remote branch "{branch}" both have new commits.
divergentModal.explanation: Git aborted the Pull operation because local and remote branches have diverged. Choose your preferred reconciliation strategy below:
divergentModal.rebaseDesc: Reapplies your local commits on top of incoming remote commits. Produces a clean, linear Git history.
divergentModal.mergeDesc: Merges the remote branch into your local branch by creating an explicit merge commit.
